source.name: Static
source.originalDescription: When damaged, paralyzes nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this Ability is decreased by 30% for 2.5s and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s. Paralyzes all enemies nearby for a short time when receiving damage. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Static は まひを付与する、通常攻撃速度を下げる。

source.name: Thunder Shock
source.originalDescription: Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them when it hits. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s. Release electricity, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also paralyzes enemies for a short time.

source.name: Electroweb
source.originalDescription: Launches an electric net at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target and immobilizing them for 1.5s when the net captures them. Attacks and captures enemies using an electric net, leaving them unable to move.

source.name: Thunderstorm
source.originalDescription: Becomes unstoppable and jumps into the air, then casts down bolts of lightning 4 times over 3s in a radius around Pikachu. The first cast targets all Pokémon on the opposing team in range with 1 bolt each; these bolts damage up to 1 target each. The following 3 casts target up to 2 random Pokémon from the opposing team in range; these following bolts deal damage to opposing Pokémon in a small area around them, but targets can only be damaged once for each of the following 3 casts. Pikachu can act freely once the first bolts of lightning are cast down. Attacks enemies near the user with tremendous bolts of lightning. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Thunderstorm は 妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する。
